KPI.WON_INFO: Cards that closed a plan in the selected period.
KPI.WIN_RATE_INFO: Of all cards that ended in the period, how many closed a plan (in %).
KPI.WON_VALUE_INFO: Total value of plans closed in the period, by currency.

META_SYNC.EMPTY: No conversions sent yet. Turn on Meta sync in a funnel. When a card closes a plan, the data shows up here.

PIPELINE_DRAWER.META_SYNC_HELP: Send each result back to Meta. This happens when a card closes a plan, does not close or moves stage. Meta then shows your Click-to-WhatsApp ads to people more likely to buy.

PIPELINE_EDITOR.AD_RESULTS_HELP: Show which ads became sales. A sale is counted when a card closes a plan, regardless of its column.

NONE.HELP: Do not send entry into this stage. Closed plans still follow the pipeline settings.

SUMMARY.NEXT_SALES: When a card moves forward or closes a plan, Meta is told and learns who buys.

FUNNEL.HINT: When a card moves forward or closes a plan in the CRM, we tell Meta. It learns to show your ad to people who buy.

REASONS.CLOSED: The customer already closed the plan. Nothing to resume here.

DESFECHO.GANHOU_TITULO_PADRAO: Plan closed! How much was it?

QUANDO.GANHO: It was when the plan closed.

ORIGIN.SUBTITLE: Plans closed and revenue, by campaign source.
ORIGIN.EMPTY: No plans closed with a campaign source in this period.

FUNIS.TIPO_SALES: Sales: ends when the plan closes or does not close

CUSTOMER.DESCRIPTION: Becomes a customer on its own when a plan closes in a sales funnel. Mark it here if they bought some other way.
